lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਭ ਸਾਜੀਅਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਵਰਤੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape srisat sabh saajeean aape varateejai ||
lines.translation: He Himself created the entire universe, and He Himself is pervading it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਸਚੁ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh sadaa salaaheeai sach keemat keejai ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukhs praise the Lord forever, and through the Truth, they assess Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਕਮਲੁ ਬਿਗਾਸਿਆ ਇਵ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gurasabadee kamal bigaasiaa iv har ras peejai ||
lines.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the heart-lotus blossoms forth, and in this way, one drinks in the sublime essence of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਠਾਕਿਆ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਵੀਜੈ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: aavan jaanaa thaakiaa sukh sahaj saveejai ||7||
lines.translation: Coming and going in reincarnation ceases, and one sleeps in peace and poise. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
lines.translation: Salok, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਮੈਲਾ ਨਾ ਧੁੰਧਲਾ ਨਾ ਭਗਵਾ ਨਾ ਕਚੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: naa mailaa naa dhu(n)dhalaa naa bhagavaa naa kach ||
lines.translation: Neither dirty, nor dull, nor saffron, nor any color that fades.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਲਾਲੋ ਲਾਲੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੈ ਰਤਾ ਸਚੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak laalo laal hai sachai rataa sach ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, crimson - deep crimson is the color of one who is imbued with the True Lord. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜਿ ਵਣਸਪਤਿ ਫੁਲੁ ਫਲੁ ਭਵਰੁ ਵਸੈ ਭੈ ਖੰਡਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sahaj vanasapat phul phal bhavar vasai bhai kha(n)d ||
lines.translation: The bumble bee intuitively and fearlessly dwells among the vegetation, flowers and fruits.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਰਵਰੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਏਕੋ ਫੁਲੁ ਭਿਰੰਗੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak taravar ek hai eko phul bhira(n)g ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, there is only one tree, one flower, and one bumble bee. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਲੂਝਹਿ ਮਨੈ ਸਿਉ ਸੇ ਸੂਰੇ ਪਰਧਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo jan loojhahi manai siu se soore paradhaanaa ||
lines.translation: Those humble beings who struggle with their minds are brave and distinguished heroes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਸਦਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੇ ਜਿਨੀ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har setee sadaa mil rahe jinee aap pachhaanaa ||
lines.translation: Those who realize their own selves, remain forever united with the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੀਆ ਕਾ ਇਹੁ ਮਹਤੁ ਹੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: giaaneeaa kaa ihu mahat hai man maahi samaanaa ||
lines.translation: This is the glory of the spiritual teachers, that they remain absorbed in their mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਚੁ ਲਾਇ ਧਿਆਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jeeu kaa mahal paaiaa sach laai dhiaanaa ||
lines.translation: They attain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, and focus their meditation on the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮਨੁ ਜੀਤਿਆ ਜਗੁ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਜਿਤਾਨਾ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: jin gur parasaadee man jeetiaa jag tinahi jitaanaa ||8||
lines.translation: Those who conquer their own minds, by Guru's Grace, conquer the world. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੀ ਹੋਵਾ ਜਗਿ ਭਵਾ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਭੀਖਿਆ ਲੇਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jogee hovaa jag bhavaa ghar ghar bheekhiaa leu ||
lines.translation: If I were to become a Yogi, and wander around the world, begging from door to door,

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਰਗਹ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਕਿਸੁ ਕਿਸੁ ਉਤਰੁ ਦੇਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: daragah lekhaa ma(n)geeai kis kis utar deu ||
lines.translation: then, when I am summoned to the Court of the Lord, what answer could I give?

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਿਖਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਮੜੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhikhiaa naam sa(n)tokh maRee sadaa sach hai naal ||
lines.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the charity I beg for; contentment is my temple. The True Lord is always with me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੇਖੀ ਹਾਥ ਨ ਲਧੀਆ ਸਭ ਬਧੀ ਜਮਕਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhekhee haath na ladheeaa sabh badhee jamakaal ||
lines.translation: Nothing is obtained by wearing religious robes; all will be seized by the Messenger of Death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗਲਾ ਝੂਠੀਆ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak galaa jhootheeaa sachaa naam samaal ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, talk is false; contemplate the True Name. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਦਰਿ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਸੋ ਦਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਹੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jit dar lekhaa ma(n)geeai so dar sevihu na koi ||
lines.translation: Through that door, you will be called to account; do not serve at that door.

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਲੋੜਿ ਲਹੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aisaa satigur loR lahu jis jevad avar na koi ||
lines.translation: Seek and find such a True Guru, who has no equal in His greatness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis saranaaee chhooteeai lekhaa ma(n)gai na koi ||
lines.translation: In His Sanctuary, one is released, and no one calls him to account.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ਸਚੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਸਚਾ ਓਹੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach driRaae sach driR sachaa ohu sabad dei ||
lines.translation: Truth is implanted within Him, and He implants Truth within others. He bestows the blessing of the True Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਜਿਸ ਦੈ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਭੀ ਸਚਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: hiradai jis dai sach hai tan man bhee sachaa hoi ||
lines.translation: One who has Truth within his heart - his body and mind are also true.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੈ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਸਚੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਦੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sachai hukam ma(n)niai sachee vadiaaee dei ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, if one submits to the Hukam, the Command of the True Lord God, he is blessed with true glory and greatness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਵਸੀ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sache maahi samaavasee jis no nadar karei ||2||
lines.translation: He is immersed and merged in the True Lord, who blesses him with His Glance of Grace. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਰੇ ਏਹਿ ਨ ਆਖੀਅਹਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: soore ehi na aakheeahi aha(n)kaar marahi dukh paavahi ||
lines.translation: They are not called heroes, who die of egotism, suffering in pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਧੇ ਆਪੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਨੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਪਚਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)dhe aap na pachhaananee doojai pach jaavahi ||
lines.translation: The blind ones do not realize their own selves; in the love of duality, they rot.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਤਿ ਕਰੋਧ ਸਿਉ ਲੂਝਦੇ ਅਗੈ ਪਿਛੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: at karodh siu loojhade agai pichhai dukh paavahi ||
lines.translation: They struggle with great anger; here and hereafter, they suffer in pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਨ ਭਾਵਈ ਵੇਦ ਕੂਕਿ ਸੁਣਾਵਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jeeu aha(n)kaar na bhaavaee ved kook sunaavahi ||
lines.translation: The Dear Lord is not pleased by egotism; the Vedas proclaim this clearly.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ਮੁਏ ਸੇ ਵਿਗਤੀ ਗਏ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਹਿ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: aha(n)kaar mue se vigatee gae mar janamahi phir aavahi ||9||
lines.translation: Those who die of egotism, shall not find salvation. They die, and are reborn in reincarnation. ||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਗਉ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਊਜਲਾ ਲੋਹੇ ਨਾਵ ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaagau hoi na oojalaa lohe naav na paar ||
lines.translation: The crow does not become white, and an iron boat does not float across.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਿਰਮ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਲੈ ਧੰਨੁ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: piram padaarath ma(n)n lai dha(n)n savaaranahaar ||
lines.translation: One who puts his faith in the treasure of his Beloved Lord is blessed; he exalts and embellishes others as well.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਊਜਲਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਸਟ ਲੋਹਾ ਪਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: hukam pachhaanai oojalaa sir kaasat lohaa paar ||
lines.translation: One who realizes the Hukam of God's Command - his face is radiant and bright; he floats across, like iron upon wood.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਛੋਡੈ ਭੈ ਵਸੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: trisanaa chhodai bhai vasai naanak karanee saar ||1||
lines.translation: Forsake thirst and desire, and abide in the Fear of God; O Nanak, these are the most excellent actions. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਾਰਣ ਜੋ ਗਏ ਮਾਰਿ ਨ ਸਕਹਿ ਗਵਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaroo maaran jo gae maar na sakahi gavaar ||
lines.translation: The ignorant people who go to the desert to conquer their minds, are not able to conquer them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੇ ਇਹੁ ਮਾਰੀਐ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak je ihu maareeai gurasabadee veechaar ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, if this mind is to be conquered, one must contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਨਾ ਮਰੈ ਜੇ ਲੋਚੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ehu man maariaa naa marai je lochai sabh koi ||
lines.translation: This mind is not conquered by conquering it, even though everyone longs to do so.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਕਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਸੀ ਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak man hee kau man maarasee je satigur bhetai soi ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the mind itself conquers the mind, if one meets with the True Guru. ||2||
